## Verdict: PASS — line (a) B-GUARD CONFIRMED fixed (lawful dangling-chain faces read and committed exactly as round S15 did, refusals back to 0), line (b) CONFIRMED fixed (MG1, MG3, MA2, MQ2 killed by pins; the S16 check's 15 killed mutants still killed); gates green but for the known foreign RELATED reds; no blocker

**(a) B-GUARD.** On the tree's engine the S16 check's own ANT faces (three roles) and BU network read and commit as
round S15's engine does — kerb(F) = F's walk for a spine-less face holding a dangling chain, corridorUnion whole,
bandUnion band 4 / blocks 4 — where round S16's engine refuses `RING_CROSSES`; this seat's wider class probe ANTX (600
faces holding dangling chains of 2 – 6 edges, straight / bent / zigzag, from the frame or T'd off a chord, dangling
trees, bridges to an island ring, two antennae; roles way without width, `wall`, `district_bound`, and ways at hw 5 /
20; kerb on every face, corridorUnion, then a wall band by bandUnion) reads 0 refusals and is field for field round
S15's output, where round S16's engine refuses 852 operations (284 cases). B-SIMPLE still holds (row-127's networks
simple, way:0's deepest 25.95 cm; 180 networks identical to round S16's reads), the census never rises and equals round
S16's at both seeds, the smoke's 26 seeds are identical field for field to the S16 check's, and no recorded pin moved
(every test file but the new `hardening-s17.test.ts` byte-equal to round S16's).

**(b) The mutants.** This seat's 37 targeted mutants (`probes/mut.py`, the item's two folders at
PLAT_FUZZ_RUNS=1000): 32 killed — among them MG1 (both guards removed), MG1r (`splitsOn`'s guard only), MG1w (the write
guard only), MG3 (no collinear clause), MA2 and MQ2, each red on its pin in `hardening-s17.test.ts`, and all 15 of the
S16 check's killed mutants. Five survive and are judged equivalent on every honest input met (0 differences in 2 208
networks / 5 789 reads, corridorUnion and bandUnion compared by result and arena state): MF3, MA4, MR1 (as in the S16
check) and two new ones on the round's guard — NB5 (`onBridge` without its collinearity test) and NB7 (the write guard
without F's bridges) — each distinguishable only by a contrived recorded region / planted piece through a seam; not a
blocker (rule (3): a further hardening test), routed as notes row 156.

The S16 line's wording asked the guard to be pinned with round S15's row-127 outline planted through bandCore's
`pieces` seam. The builder's finding (row 148 (b)) that the cut pieces lose the crossing edge (it lies on face 0's
bridge within the hot pixel) is re-measured here (the unit pin asserting the three pieces and `outlineCrosses` false is
green; the pieces are what `outlinePieces` cuts); the outline is pinned where it is met whole — `splitsOn` on the
recorded region, refused `RING_CROSSES` — and the write guard on three crossing outlines through the seam. MG1 / MG1r /
MG1w / MG3 are each killed by those pins: the required change is met in substance. CONFIRMED.
